d:
An open heart is not something you achieve once. It's a decision you make in the morning and again in the evening
It would be easier to stay behind our walls. Nothing can hurt us there, but nothing can reach us either. No love, no trust, no real closeness. Life only comes in as far as we let it come in.
So we stay open. Not because it's easy, but because everything that matters lives on the other side of that choice. An open heart is not weakness. It's the ground everything else grows from.
And slowly the world becomes softer around us. And we become softer with it.
